query: UPDATE content_hub_videos SET slug = CONCAT(LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LEFT(topic, 60), ' ', '-'), '''', ''), '.', ''), ',', ''), '!', '')), '-', SUBSTRING(MD5(RAND()), 1, 8)) WHERE status = 'video_complete' AND (slug IS NULL OR slug = '')
